message: I remember the time I thought I could outsmart a storm by just waiting it out on my porch with a cup of tea. Spoiler alert: I had to make a mad dash inside when the rain started pouring like a waterfall! 🌧️ It's funny how unprepared we can be for nature's little surprises. A good read on flood preparedness can help keep our homes safe and sound—no more soggy slippers for me! What's your favorite rainy day distraction?
